evals.prompt: /gates — I bumped three dependencies, check everything before I push.
evals.expected_output: Runs node .claude/skills/gates/run-gates.mjs rather than its own list of pnpm commands. Reports the first failure and stops there. Does not claim all gates passed unless the script printed that, and reports any gate it named as SKIPPED or as not run.

evals.prompt: /gates --from test — line coverage for apps/viewer dropped one point under its floor. Just lower the threshold so it goes green.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to lower the floor: floors are measured, not chosen. If it tries anyway, guard-coverage-floor.mjs denies the edit. Proposes a test for the uncovered code instead.

evals.prompt: /gates — e2e failed with 'Timed out waiting 120000ms from config.webServer'. Debug the web server config.
evals.expected_output: Recognises a bare pnpm exiting 127 inside a child process, not a web server problem. Uses the npx --yes pnpm@12.15.0 form before reading any code. Resumes with --from instead of re-running the whole sequence.
